baseline.mechanism: Preserved ObservedGainCalibration starts Beta(1,1); feedback_enabled=False keeps alpha/beta fixed. Only its probability prediction is compared on identical actual frozen events; not a physical no-feedback-policy run.

equations.p_online: (1+sum previous s)/(2+sum previous n), stored posterior_before checked exactly
equations.expected_conditional_gain: p*n; target is s, not s+outside

unit_of_analysis: Three recorded episodes: one short S3/G3 functional pair and one optimized S26 continuation sharing the G3-created RTAB map. Not three independent scenes; no independence/significance claim for 32 actions or 695 cell events.
limitations: The channel named radar tests new known occupancy cells after combined RGB-D/scan fusion, not isolated lidar detection accuracy.
Frozen before/after prediction-epoch arrays are used; optimized-history map-area growth is not relabelled as observed gain.
Same-event retrospective baseline predictions do not represent a new no-feedback trajectory or prove exploration efficiency.
Predicted-mask yield excludes unpredicted realized cells; outside counts are reported separately.
All completed actions retained, including empty predicted masks and ROS4 failures; pending action27 has no completed feedback and no invented label.
No per-cell or per-action independence assumption, significance test, confidence interval, or generalization claim.
Camera prediction masks are empty throughout; no camera gain learning benefit is established.
